name: with_memory_limit
signature: fn with_memory_limit(self, max_memory: usize, memory_fraction: f64) -> Self
docs:
Specify the total memory to use while running the DataFusion
plan to `max_memory * memory_fraction` in bytes.

This defaults to using [`GreedyMemoryPool`] wrapped in the
[`TrackConsumersPool`] with a maximum of 5 consumers.

Note DataFusion does not yet respect this limit in all cases.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.
